pages.observed: Five samples 0.0 to 0.8 s of option a. Airport curbside under a pale canopy, phone card top left reads Ride requested with a blue route line. A white SUV with a roof sensor drives in from the left edge and by 0.8 s is near the left end of a painted pickup bay. Caption box at mid frame from 0.2 s. Lower half of frame is plain dark road.

Samples 1.0 to 1.8 s of option a. The white SUV has stopped within the painted pickup bay under the canopy with a red glow at its rear. Phone card still reads Ride requested. Caption at mid frame unchanged. Lower half of frame remains empty dark road with a dashed lane edge.

Samples 2.0 to 2.8 s of option a. Exterior curb shot holds the parked SUV through 2.4 s while a small Texas outline card appears top right. At 2.6 s the view cuts inside the cab: steering wheel, empty front seats, dash screen with a blue route, windshield showing the airport pickup sign. Phone card and caption persist.

Samples 3.0 to 3.8 s of option a, interior cab view. The steering wheel turns with nobody in the seat, its tan marker rotating clockwise. The airport sign moves right across the windshield and is mostly out of frame by 3.6 s. Dash screen route dot advances. Texas outline card at top right shows a drawn state shape. Lower third of frame is grey seat backs.

Samples 4.0 to 4.8 s of option a. The interior cab view is held: empty seats, wheel turned with marker at right, dash route screen, pale windshield with only a cut-off sign edge at right. Texas card at top right. Caption unchanged. No visible new action across the five samples.

Samples 5.0 to 5.8 s of option a. Cab interior through 5.2 s, then a cut to a medium curb shot: a large phone tilted at left foreground shows the blue route and Ride requested, the white SUV sits in the painted bay beneath the airport sign. Caption reads the airport included. Texas card gains a small ring mark. Bottom third of frame is dark road.

Samples 6.0 to 6.8 s of option a. Same medium curb composition. On the phone the car icon reaches the pin and the status text changes from Ride requested to Arriving, At the curb, by 6.2 s. The white SUV holds in the painted bay. Caption the airport included disappears by 6.6 s. Lower third of frame is plain dark road.

Samples 7.0 to 7.8 s of option a. New shot: a cream gridded street map lies on a brown plank table seen in perspective, a small February calendar page stands at its top right edge. The map carries a few small pin marks and faint green patches; detail is small at phone size. By 7.8 s thin blue line strokes start to appear on the map. Caption The service began in February.

Samples 8.0 to 8.8 s of option a. Tabletop map shot held. Blue river strokes and thin grey road lines, including a faint loop, progressively draw over the cream map around a cluster of pins near the centre. Lines are thin and small relative to the frame. The Texas locator card fades away at 8.0 s. Caption unchanged.

Samples 9.0 to 9.8 s of option a. Tabletop map held to 9.2 s, then a closer framing makes the map fill the upper two thirds. A white label card reading 60 square miles, Limited area, lands near the top of the map with a black leader line toward a green patch. The February calendar page slides in at lower right. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles. No drawn boundary of the limited area is distinguishable in these samples beyond the existing faint ring road.

Samples 10.0 to 10.8 s of option a. Closer map framing held. A thin black outline begins at the label and extends clockwise down the right side of the city centre, reaching about a third of a loop by 10.8 s. February page now sits at the map's lower left. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles. The outline is thin and the interior is not filled.

Samples 11.0 to 11.8 s of option a. The black outline closes into an irregular polygon around the city centre and its three pins, and the polygon interior turns a translucent grey from 11.2 s. The label 60 square miles sits above it and the February page at lower left. Caption unchanged. Bottom third is brown plank table.

Samples 12.0 to 12.8 s of option a. The map with the closed grey zone is held. A tiny white car shape appears next to the lower left pin inside the zone. The caption disappears at 12.8 s. Throughout 12.4 to 12.8 s the picture is still the tabletop map; there is no creek, water or bank in frame.

Samples 13.0 to 13.8 s of option a. At 13.2 s the film cuts from the map to a creek view: a pale layered stone band runs across the full frame width at about mid height under a large tree, and broad brown water fills the bottom 60 percent. The white SUV sits on the stone ledge with a vertical dark drop under its front; to the right of that drop a slightly lighter brown area meets the ledge. The ledge's lower boundary reads as a long near-horizontal edge across the frame at phone size. No distinct white water is resolvable at the drop at this size; pale rock shapes sit at the right edge. Disclosure changes to A different car, April 20th account.

Samples 14.0 to 14.8 s of option a. Same creek framing, camera static. The white SUV stays at about the same place on the stone ledge's front edge, with its underside meeting the brown water and a small white curl at its rear right from 14.6 s. The pale stone band spans the full frame width; its lower boundary against the water reads as a long nearly horizontal line at phone size. To the right of the vertical drop under the car, a slightly lighter brown area is bounded below by a faint horizontal edge, giving a squared shape. No downstream travel of the car is visible within these five samples.

Samples 15.0 to 15.8 s of option a. The SUV is now floating in the brown water below the stone ledge with a reflection beneath it and a white wake curl behind its right side; it drifts slowly leftward under the large tree. At about 15.4 s the framing tightens. The pale stone ledge still runs edge to edge across the frame and its lower boundary against the water reads as one long near-horizontal line. The vertical drop and pale right-edge rocks seen earlier are no longer in frame after 15.4 s. No white water at a lip is distinguishable in these samples.

Samples 16.0 to 16.8 s of option a. Camera held at the tighter creek framing. The SUV is sunk to its window line with a reflection and white wake curl, and drifts left across the frame past the fixed tree trunk. Right of the car a vertical pale line drops from the ledge into the water, with a lighter brown area to its right; two small pale rectangular flecks sit on the water near it. The stone ledge still spans the full width with a long near-horizontal lower edge against the water.

Samples 17.0 to 17.8 s of option a. Creek shot: the sunk SUV drifts to the left frame edge past the fixed tree by 17.4 s. Right of centre a jagged vertical drop with a pale edge runs from the ledge down into the water, with small pale rectangular flecks beside it. The ledge spans the frame with a long near-horizontal lower edge. At 17.6 s the film cuts to a street scene: a house, tree and street signs behind a white SUV standing in shallow brown floodwater with a reflection, a dark grey shape at right edge, and a tiled sidewalk filling the lower 40 percent. Disclosure reads Another car, earlier in April.

Samples 18.0 to 18.8 s of option a. Flooded street shot held: a white SUV stands in brown floodwater in front of a house, tree and street signs, its wheels going under as it settles slightly deeper and shifts a little right. A dark grey shape at right edge slides out by 18.6 s. No amber hazard lamps are distinguishable on the car at this size. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater. Tiled sidewalk fills the lower 40 percent.

Samples 19.0 to 19.8 s of option a. The stranded white SUV holds in the brown street floodwater with its wheels under. From 19.6 s small amber lamps glow at its front and rear corners. The lamps are small at phone size. Same house, tree, sign and sidewalk composition. Caption unchanged.

Samples 20.0 to 20.8 s of option a. Closer side shot of the stranded SUV in brown water, empty seats visible through its windows. Amber lamps at both ends blink on and off between samples, now readable at phone size. Background house, tree and green signs are softer. Caption unchanged. Sidewalk fills the lower third.

Samples 21.0 to 21.8 s of option a. The closer stranded-car shot continues: the white SUV sits in brown floodwater, its amber lamps blinking at front and rear; the car itself does not move and the camera holds. Background soft. Caption unchanged. This continues the same held tableau begun at 20.0 s.

Samples 22.0 to 22.8 s of option a. After the stranded car at 22.0 s, the film cuts to a wall view: plain olive green wall top and bottom, a brown desk band across the middle, and a cream card titled Federal recall record, Vehicle safety recall, tilted and cut off at the right frame edge with a pen beside it. At 22.8 s partial typed text Reca and Sof starts appearing. Caption Waymo filed a software recall from 22.4 s.

Samples 23.0 to 23.8 s of option a. The record card moves to the centre of the desk band and its fields are typed in: Recall type Software, then Potential units affected 3,791, complete by 23.8 s. A pen lies at its lower right corner. Olive wall fills the top and bottom thirds. Caption Waymo filed a software recall.

Samples 24.0 to 24.8 s of option a. The completed recall card holds on the desk through 24.4 s, then the framing shifts so the card sits at the top and a grid of faint rounded slots appears on the desk below. By 24.8 s three white car icons fill the first slots, row one, from the left. Caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.

Samples 25.0 to 25.8 s of option a. The grid of white car icons fills progressively, reaching about forty eight icons by 25.8 s. From 25.4 s a hand in a blue sleeve enters from the right carrying a wooden stamp block and by 25.8 s holds it over the card's upper right area. Card and caption unchanged. Olive wall fills the bottom quarter.

Samples 26.0 to 26.8 s of option a. The blue-sleeved hand presses a wooden stamp on the recall card. The car-icon grid is full at five rows of ten. A paper tag reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record, drops in tilted and settles between the card and grid. At 26.8 s the stamp lifts a little to reveal a yellow-bordered stamped mark beginning with So. Caption unchanged.

Samples 27.0 to 27.8 s of option a. The hand lifts the stamp and withdraws to the right, leaving a yellow-bordered Software recall stamp on the card's upper right. The Nearly 3,800 vehicles tag and the full grid of fifty white car icons hold below. The stamped text is small at phone size. Caption unchanged.

Samples 28.0 to 28.8 s of option a. The record desk holds without caption to 28.2 s. At 28.4 s it cuts to a side view of a wide grey road with a street lamp, trees and skyline behind and a grass verge below; the white SUV enters from the left edge and moves right. Disclosure changes to The recall wording, not a recorded event. At 28.8 s a faint panel with quoted recall wording fades in above the scene. Caption The recall says the software may let a car slow.

Samples 29.0 to 29.8 s of option a. The quote panel now sits fully legible at the top. The white SUV rides along the grey road near frame centre left while lane dashes, lamp and skyline scroll left behind it. No water is visible on the road yet. Grass verge fills the lower 40 percent under the caption.

Samples 30.0 to 30.8 s of option a. The SUV continues along the road with scenery scrolling left. Its rear brake lamp glows red from 30.6 s. At 30.8 s a pale grey oval patch on the road surface enters at the right edge ahead of the car. Quote panel and caption unchanged.

Samples 31.0 to 31.8 s of option a. The background stops scrolling and the car itself creeps right toward the centre, brake lamps glowing early in the interval. A pale grey oval of standing water sits at the right end of the road, ahead of the car, its lower part overlapping the caption band. Quote panel and caption unchanged.

Samples 32.0 to 32.8 s of option a. The SUV continues right toward the grey water patch; the patch remains partly under the caption until the caption clears at 32.6 s. At 32.8 s the film cuts to a close side view of the car on the road with a thin wavy white line under its wheels; the quote panel stays at top, a lamp post and tree behind. The water at contact is only the thin line at this frame.

Samples 33.0 to 33.8 s of option a. Close side shot of the white SUV with a light streak ahead of it and thin wavy white lines under the wheels. A pale grey pool of standing water slides in from the right edge just ahead of the front wheel and grows through the interval; the car has not yet entered it by 33.8 s. Caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.

Samples 34.0 to 34.8 s of option a. Close side shot: the pale grey pool now reaches the front wheel, and by 34.8 s the front wheel sits in the pool with small splash lines. In the quote panel the word may is highlighted in amber from 34.2 s. The car body and camera hold. Caption unchanged.

Samples 35.0 to 35.8 s of option a. The SUV is now in the grey standing water, both wheels in it, with reflection and white wake lines spreading underneath and behind. Camera and car position hold. The quote panel keeps may highlighted. Caption unchanged.

Samples 36.0 to 36.8 s of option a. The SUV stays in frame in the grey standing water with reflections and wake lines while the background tree and lamp post slide left, so the car reads as rolling on through the water. The caption disappears at 36.6 s. Quote panel holds with may highlighted.

Samples 37.0 to 37.8 s of option a. The film returns to the recall card on the desk, larger in frame. A new Remedy row types in on the lower card with a pale amber background, reading The remedy is currently under development., complete at 37.6 s. Caption The federal record says the remedy is currently under development.

Samples 38.0 to 38.8 s of option a. The completed recall card holds. From 38.2 s a hand in a blue sleeve holding a pen reaches in from the right and by 38.6 s its pen tip rests at the end of the line The remedy is currently under development. Caption unchanged.

Samples 39.0 to 39.8 s of option a. While the pen hand holds at the Remedy line, a second blue-sleeved forearm reaches in from the lower right carrying a wooden stamp block and moves it to the lower left of the Remedy box. Two separate arms enter from the right edge with no body shown. Slight push in at 39.2 s. Caption unchanged.

Samples 40.0 to 40.8 s of option a. The second hand presses the wooden stamp on the lower Remedy area and then lifts and pulls it right, revealing a yellow-bordered Under development stamp mark by 40.6 s. The pen hand holds at the remedy line throughout. Caption unchanged.

Samples 41.0 to 41.8 s of option a. The pen and stamp hands withdraw right leaving the card with both stamps. At 41.6 s the film cuts to a wet lot where four white SUVs are parked in a diagonal row under an overhead wire; a small page hangs on the wire and an April calendar page stands at right. At 41.8 s a tag ending in ther limits slides in at upper left. Caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits.

Samples 42.0 to 42.8 s of option a. Same lot: four white SUVs parked in a row on wet pavement. A tag reading Weather limits, tightened, with a small rain cloud icon slides in from the left and hangs on the overhead wire by 42.4 s. The cars stay still. Caption unchanged. Lower 30 percent of frame is empty wet pavement.

Samples 43.0 to 43.8 s of option a. The lot shot holds with the four parked SUVs unchanged. Only the Weather limits tag moves, drifting right along the wire and tilting slightly by 43.8 s. Caption unchanged. This continues the same tableau from 41.6 s.

Samples 44.0 to 44.8 s of option a. The parked-car lot tableau continues unchanged except for a tiny sway of the Weather limits tag. The four SUVs stay parked, the camera holds and the caption is unchanged. This is now about 3.2 s of the same arrangement since 41.6 s.

Samples 45.0 to 45.8 s of option a. The lot tableau holds through 45.4 s. At 45.6 s the framing changes to a closer, lower view along the parked row: the nearest SUV fills the left half, others recede right, with reflections on wet pavement; the Weather limits tag and April page sit above. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. No visible update action such as a light, icon or progress state appears on the cars in these samples.

Samples 46.0 to 46.8 s of option a. In the close row view, round check-mark badges appear one after another above each parked SUV's roof sensor, front car first, then the cars behind it, smaller with distance. By 46.8 s four badges are visible. Cars and camera stay still. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth.

Samples 47.0 to 47.8 s of option a. All four visible cars carry check badges. A small check circle completes beside the Vehicle maps page at 47.4 s, with a tiny sub-label that is not legible at phone size. Everything else holds still. Caption unchanged.

Samples 48.0 to 48.8 s of option a. The checked row of parked SUVs holds unchanged through 48.6 s. At 48.8 s the small calendar on the post flips from April to a page with a large 20. Caption unchanged.

Samples 49.0 to 49.8 s of option a. The checked row of parked cars holds. The calendar now reads April 20 while the previous sheet lifts off above it. The caption disappears at 49.8 s. This lot arrangement has been on screen since 41.6 s with two framings.

Samples 50.0 to 50.8 s of option a. The film returns to the opening airport curb wide: canopy, airport sign, suitcase, bench and the white SUV parked in the painted bay, with the phone card now reading Arriving. Disclosure reads A generic airport ride, not the flood cars. Caption So the airport ride is open. No movement visible across the samples; the lower 40 percent is empty road.

Samples 51.0 to 51.8 s of option a. In the airport curb wide, the parked SUV's rear passenger door opens outward from 51.2 s and is fully open by 51.8 s; no person enters. The door is small at phone size. Caption So the airport ride is open. Lower 40 percent of the frame is empty road.

Samples 52.0 to 52.8 s of option a. The open-door curb wide holds through 52.6 s, caption clearing at 52.6 s. At 52.8 s the framing changes: the phone card is gone, the car with its door open sits smaller at mid frame, and a small tilted recall card reading The remedy is currently under development lies on the road surface in the foreground. A small phone shape stands near the bench. Card text is small at phone size.

Samples 53.0 to 53.8 s of option a. The closer curb view holds: the SUV with its rear door open sits in the bay under the airport sign; a small recall card reading The remedy is currently under development lies tilted on the road above the caption and drifts slightly left. A small phone shape stands propped near the bench. Caption and the federal record lists the flood remedy. Lower 40 percent of frame is empty road.

Samples 54.0 to 54.8 s of option a. The recall card on the road grows larger and straightens, its Remedy line The remedy is currently under development now readable, and slides across the frame so that its top edge overlaps the bottom of the car with the open door. The car and sign hold behind it. Caption and the federal record lists the flood remedy.

Samples 55.0 to 55.8 s of option a. The pairing is held: the open-door SUV in the pickup bay behind and the large recall card with its Remedy line just below, the card's top edge overlapping the car's wheels. Only slight card drift. Caption unchanged.

Samples 56.0 to 56.8 s of option a. After the card-and-car pairing, at 56.4 s the frame becomes a two-part composition: the open-door SUV in the pickup bay fills the top half, and a brown desk below holds the recall card with its Remedy line and a small phone showing a route. Caption as currently under development.

Samples 57.0 to 57.8 s of option a. Split composition held: the open-door SUV at the curb above, the recall card and small phone on the desk below. A dark underline draws progressively under the words under development on the card. Caption as currently under development. Lower third of frame is plain brown desk.

Samples 58.0 to 58.8 s of option a. The final split picture of the open-door car above the recall card holds until 58.4 s with the underline complete. At 58.6 s the film cuts to a dark credits card with a Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com and a list of sources, illustration note, map note and music licence.

Samples 59.0 to 59.8 s of option a. The dark credits card holds without change: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, sources Waymo October 14th, NHTSA recall 26E026, Texas Public Radio May 10th and 13th, illustration and map notes, and the music licence.

Samples 60.0 to 60.8 s of option a. The same dark credits card with the Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com and the source, illustration, map and music credits holds with no change across all five samples.

Samples 61.0 to 61.8 s of option a. The dark credits card with Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com and source, illustration, map and music credits holds unchanged in all five samples.
Samples 62.0 to 62.8 s of option a. The dark credits card with the Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com and the credit list holds unchanged in all five samples.
Samples 63.0, 63.2, 63.4 and final frame 63.433 s of option a. The dark credits card with Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com and credits holds unchanged to the last frame.

Samples 0.0 to 0.8 s of option b. Same airport curb opening as option a: phone card Ride requested at top left, airport sign, canopy, suitcase; the white SUV enters from the left edge and approaches the painted pickup bay by 0.8 s. Caption from 0.2 s. Lower 40 percent of frame is empty dark road.

Samples 1.0 to 1.8 s of option b. The white SUV has stopped inside the painted pickup bay with a red glow at its rear. Phone card Ride requested and caption unchanged. Lower 40 percent of frame empty road.

Samples 2.0 to 2.8 s of option b. The curb shot holds with the parked SUV while a Texas outline card fades in at top right. At 2.6 s the film cuts inside the cab: wheel, empty seats, dash route screen and the airport sign through the windshield. Phone card and caption persist. Same composition as option a at these times.

Samples 3.0 to 3.8 s of option b. Interior cab shot: the empty driver seat, the steering wheel turning on its own with its tan marker rotating clockwise, the airport sign sliding out of the windshield to the right, and the dash route dot advancing. The Texas outline completes in the top right card. Lower third grey seat backs. Same as option a here.

Samples 4.0 to 4.8 s of option b. The interior cab view holds: wheel turned with marker at right, empty seats, dash route screen, mostly blank pale windshield with only a sign edge at right, Texas outline card at top right. No visible change across the five samples.

Samples 5.0 to 5.8 s of option b. Cab interior through 5.2 s, then a cut to the curb medium shot: large tilted phone at left reading Ride requested, white SUV in the pickup bay under the airport sign. A small ring marks south central Texas on the locator card. Caption the airport included. Same as option a.

Samples 6.0 to 6.8 s of option b. On the large phone the car icon reaches the destination pin and the status reads Arriving, At the curb from 6.2 s. The real SUV stays in the pickup bay behind. Caption clears at 6.6 s. Same as option a.

Samples 7.0 to 7.8 s of option b. Unlike option a's perspective tabletop, option b cuts to a straight overhead map: a cream gridded sheet on an olive surface with three small pins, two green patches and a February calendar page at lower left; the Texas locator card stays top right. Blue and grey strokes begin to draw at 7.8 s. Caption The service began in February. Lower 30 percent of frame is plain olive.

Samples 8.0 to 8.8 s of option b. On the overhead map two blue rivers draw from top to bottom and grey radial roads and a faint loop road spread from the centre around the three pins. The Texas card fades away at 8.0 s. Caption unchanged. Lines are thin at phone size.

Samples 9.0 to 9.8 s of option b. The overhead map holds through 9.2 s, then the frame shows the same map lying on a brown plank table with the planks converging at the bottom. A label 60 square miles, Limited area, lands on the map with a leader line toward a green patch and the February page slides in from the right. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles.

Samples 10.0 to 10.8 s of option b. On the tabletop map a thin black outline grows from the label clockwise around the right side of the centre, reaching about a third of a loop by 10.8 s, while the February page moves to the lower left. Caption unchanged. Same event as option a, different framing with a steeper table.

Samples 11.0 to 11.8 s of option b. The black outline completes into an irregular polygon around the three pins and fills translucent grey from 11.2 s, holding through 11.8 s. Label above, February page at lower left. Caption unchanged.

Samples 12.0 to 12.8 s of option b. The filled zone map holds on the plank table; a tiny white car shape appears by the lower left pin inside the zone. Caption clears at 12.8 s. Through 12.8 s the picture is still the map; no creek water or bank is shown in this interval.

Samples 13.0 to 13.8 s of option b. At 13.2 s the film cuts from the map to a top-down creek: a brown channel runs across the frame between two pale wavy banks, with round tree crowns on green ground above and below. A white car seen from above sits in the water close to the lower bank, with a pale curved line on the water trailing from the right to its rear and a thin dark line ahead of its front. Both bank edges are wavy, not straight. No distinct lip or white water is identifiable at phone size. Disclosure changes to A different car, April 20th account.

Samples 14.0 to 14.8 s of option b. The overhead creek holds: brown water between two pale wavy banks, the white car in the water against the lower bank with a pale curved line trailing right and a thin dark line ahead. The car does not travel downstream across these five samples. Both banks remain wavy with no straight full-width edge. No lip or white water is identifiable at phone size.

Samples 15.0 to 15.8 s of option b. The overhead creek holds to 15.2 s with the car beginning to move left. At 15.4 s it cuts to an eye-level view similar to option a's creek: a pale layered stone ledge runs across the full width under a large tree, and the white SUV floats in brown water with a reflection and a white wake curl, drifting left. The ledge's lower boundary against the water reads as one long near-horizontal line across the frame at phone size. No separate lip with white water is identifiable here.

Samples 16.0 to 16.8 s of option b. Eye-level creek, camera held. The SUV, sunk to its window line with a reflection and a white wake curl, drifts left past the fixed tree trunk. Right of the wake a pale vertical line drops from the ledge into the water. The pale stone ledge spans the full width with a long near-horizontal lower edge against the water. This matches option a's creek framing at the same times.

Samples 17.0 to 17.8 s of option b. In the eye-level creek the sunk SUV drifts to the left frame edge by 17.4 s. Right of centre a jagged vertical drop with a pale edge runs from the stone ledge down into the water; to its right the water area looks slightly different in tone, bounded below by a faint near-horizontal transition, which is hard to resolve at phone size. The ledge spans the full width. At 17.6 s the film cuts to the flooded street: house, tree, signs, a white SUV in shallow brown water with a reflection, a dark grey shape at right, and tiled sidewalk below.

Samples 18.0 to 18.8 s of option b. Flooded street wide: the white SUV in brown water before a house and street signs settles deeper and shifts slightly right as its wheels go under; the grey shape at right exits. No hazard lamps distinguishable yet. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater. Same composition as option a here.

Samples 19.0 to 19.8 s of option b. The stranded SUV holds in the street floodwater; small amber lamps glow at its front and rear from 19.6 s. Lamps are small at phone size. Same as option a at these times.
Samples 20.0 to 20.8 s of option b. Closer side shot of the stranded SUV in brown water with empty seats visible; amber lamps at both ends blink. Background soft. Same as option a at these times.
Samples 21.0 to 21.8 s of option b. The close stranded-car shot continues with the amber lamps blinking; the car and camera hold still. Same held tableau as option a from 20.0 s.

Samples 22.0 to 22.8 s of option b. After the stranded car at 22.0 s, the film cuts to a top-down brown desk panel on an olive background, with a cream Federal recall record card tilted in from the right edge and a pen at lower right. Text begins typing at 22.8 s. Caption Waymo filed a software recall. Desk is seen from above in option b, versus a front-on wall-and-desk band in option a.

Samples 23.0 to 23.8 s of option b. The recall card on the overhead desk straightens and centres; Recall type Software is complete and Potential units affected 3,791 types in by 23.8 s. Pen at lower right. Caption unchanged. Lower 30 percent of frame plain olive.

Samples 24.0 to 24.8 s of option b. The completed recall card holds, then at 24.6 s the frame changes to the card at top with a grid of faint slots on a brown desk band below; three white car icons fill the first slots by 24.8 s. Caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars. Same layout as option a from this point.

Samples 25.0 to 25.8 s of option b. The car-icon grid fills progressively below the card while a blue-sleeved hand carries a wooden stamp in from the right and reaches the card's upper right by 25.8 s. Caption unchanged. Same as option a.

Samples 26.0 to 26.8 s of option b. The hand presses the stamp on the card while the full fifty-icon grid sits below; the Nearly 3,800 vehicles tag drops in and settles, and the stamp lifts to show a yellow-bordered mark beginning So at 26.8 s. Same as option a.

Samples 27.0 to 27.8 s of option b. The hand and stamp withdraw to the right, leaving a yellow-bordered Software recall stamp on the card above the Nearly 3,800 vehicles tag and the full grid of car icons. Caption unchanged. Same as option a.

Samples 28.0 to 28.8 s of option b. The record desk holds to 28.2 s, then cuts to a straight overhead road with white lane dashes and green verges; a white car seen from above travels up the right lane, partly behind the caption box at 28.6 s. A faint quote panel fades in at the top at 28.8 s. Disclosure The recall wording, not a recorded event.

Samples 29.0 to 29.8 s of option b. Overhead road: the white car stays near mid frame while lane dashes scroll past, reading as forward travel. The quote panel is legible at top. From 29.2 s a pale grey patch of standing water enters at the top edge of the road ahead and grows; its upper part sits behind the disclosure and quote panels. Caption unchanged.

Samples 30.0 to 30.8 s of option b. In the overhead road the grey standing water patch slides down toward the car, its upper part largely behind the quote panel; by 30.8 s its lower edge reaches just above the panel bottom. Red brake dots show at the car's rear at 30.8 s. Caption unchanged.

Samples 31.0 to 31.8 s of option b. The car, brake dots lit, edges up the left lane and holds below the grey water patch, which now reaches down past the quote panel on the right side of the road, about one car length ahead. Caption unchanged.

Samples 32.0 to 32.8 s of option b. Overhead, the car creeps toward the grey water patch, still separated by a short gap at 32.6 s; caption clears at 32.6 s.
